top_signals.title: Stocks Fall as Chip Slump Overshadows Oil Drop: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks fell as a deepening rout in chipmakers eclipsed gains elsewhere that were buoyed by lower oil prices and falling bond yields.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: U.S. and Korean tech stocks are now tightly linked — and that could be a worry for investors
top_signals.summary: The 60-day correlation between the Kospi and Nasdaq 100 recently climbed to about 0.50, its highest level since 2021, according to data provided by Rayliant.

top_signals.title: Tsunami alert issued after magnitude 7.1 quake strikes Kumamoto
top_signals.summary: The quake registered up to shindo 7, the highest level on the Japanese seismic intensity scale.
